this.wfAction = WorkflowActionQueryExecutor.getInstance().get(WorkflowActionQuery.GET_ACTION, actionId);
```

This ensures that the Recovery Service can properly handle all action types, thus preventing the incorrect picking up of killed control nodes and maintaining consistency in workflow action state management.
